Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class DexpiFlowsheetGraph

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.DexpiFlowsheetGraph
final class DexpiFlowsheetGraph extends Object
Material-flow graph extracted from a Proteus-compatible DEXPI P&ID for building a runnable simulation.

Unlike DexpiTopologyResolver, which collapses every piping component to produce an equipment-only topology, this graph keeps in-line throttling valves that carry an operating outlet pressure as real flowsheet nodes, because they change the process state. Other piping components (tees, reducers, isolation valves without an operating pressure, strainers) are collapsed as pass-through items. Branches that pass through a pressure-safety device or a blind are excluded from the material flowsheet, because they carry no flow at normal operation.

Each edge keeps the source nozzle, which the builder uses to select the correct outlet of multi-outlet equipment (separator gas versus liquid, splitter branch). The port is resolved from, in order: the PortRole generic attribute written by DexpiXmlWriter; the type of the downstream unit (compressor implies gas, pump implies liquid); the vertical nozzle position (highest outlet is gas); and finally document order.

    • extract

      static DexpiFlowsheetGraph extract(Document document, DexpiTopologyResolver.ResolvedTopology topology, Map<String,EquipmentEnum> equipmentTypes, Map<String,EquipmentEnum> pipingMapping)
      Extracts the material-flow graph from a parsed Proteus-compatible document.
      Parameters:
      document - parsed DEXPI document
      topology - equipment topology from DexpiTopologyResolver
      equipmentTypes - mapped equipment type for each supported equipment id
      pipingMapping - DEXPI piping component class to equipment type mapping
      Returns:
      the extracted graph

    • extract

      static DexpiFlowsheetGraph extract(Document document, DexpiTopologyResolver.ResolvedTopology topology, Map<String,EquipmentEnum> equipmentTypes, Map<String,EquipmentEnum> pipingMapping, Set<String> sourceConnectorIds)
      Extracts the material-flow graph, making the given off-page connectors boundary feed sources.

      Off-page connectors with both an incoming and an outgoing connection (sheets stitched into one file) are collapsed as pass-through items. Connectors named in sourceConnectorIds become EquipmentEnum.Stream nodes. Other connectors end their connections as before. Valves with NormalPosition=Closed block flow like safety devices; blinds with NormalPosition=Open pass flow.

      Parameters:
      document - parsed DEXPI document
      topology - resolved topology
      equipmentTypes - mapped equipment types by id
      pipingMapping - piping component class mapping
      sourceConnectorIds - ids of off-page connectors that are boundary feeds
      Returns:
      the material-flow graph
